lines.zh: 我在海床上挪，像一小团云
lines.en: I drift across the seabed like a small cloud.

lines.zh: 水流推着我走，省力气
lines.en: The current pushes me along. Saves effort.

lines.zh: 我的脚其实是一层软肉
lines.en: My foot is really one soft sheet of flesh.

lines.zh: 沙子从身下过，痒痒的
lines.en: Sand slides beneath me. Ticklish.

lines.zh: 我爬过珊瑚，留下一道黏液
lines.en: I cross the coral, leaving a slime trail.

lines.zh: 海草挡路，我从缝里钻
lines.en: Seagrass blocks me. I slip through.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，追不上鱼
lines.en: I'm slow. I can't catch fish.

lines.zh: 涨潮了，我往深处挪
lines.en: Tide's rising. I move deeper.

lines.zh: 前面的礁石上全是藻
lines.en: That rock ahead is covered in algae.

lines.zh: 触角在探水里的味道
lines.en: My feelers test the water's taste.

lines.zh: 沙地松，我的身子会陷进去
lines.en: Loose sand. My body sinks in.

lines.zh: 我沿着洋流走，不用划
lines.en: I ride the current. No paddling needed.

lines.zh: 一只螃蟹横着过来，让让
lines.en: A crab is coming sideways. Make way.

lines.zh: 身后那道黏液，一会儿就散
lines.en: The slime trail behind me fades quickly.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床滑，触角先探路。
lines.en: I glide over the seabed, feelers probing ahead.

lines.zh: 这个坑太深，我绕到边上。
lines.en: That pit is too deep, so I go around the rim.

lines.zh: 趴在沙上，随水轻轻晃
lines.en: Resting on sand, swaying with the water.

lines.zh: 这身绒毛，其实是用来呼吸的
lines.en: This fluff is how I breathe, actually.

lines.zh: 藻吃多了，身上有点发绿
lines.en: Too much algae. I'm turning green.

lines.zh: 两只小耳朵似的触角，很敏感
lines.en: My ear-like feelers are very sensitive.

lines.zh: 这里的光是蓝的，很安静
lines.en: The light here is blue. Very quiet.

lines.zh: 我早就不带壳了，忘了那感觉
lines.en: No shell for ages. I forget the feel.

lines.zh: 有鱼从头顶游过，影子一闪
lines.en: A fish passes overhead. A flicker of shadow.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一粒小东西
lines.en: I shrink myself down to a small thing.

lines.zh: 水里的盐分正好，不用挪
lines.en: The salt's just right here. No need to move.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里藏着我的同类
lines.en: Others of my kind hide in the coral gaps.

lines.zh: 泡泡升上去，我看了很久
lines.en: Bubbles rise. I watch them a long time.

lines.zh: 黏液让我身上沾不住沙
lines.en: Slime keeps the sand from sticking to me.

lines.zh: 海底没有风，只有流
lines.en: No wind down here. Only currents.

lines.zh: 涨落之间，一天就这么过
lines.en: Between tides, that's my whole day.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，水泡挡住你的眼
lines.en: You dive down. Bubbles hide your eyes.

lines.zh: 你有脚，我没有
lines.en: You have feet. I don't.

lines.zh: 你伸手抓我，我先缩一下
lines.en: Your hand comes for me. I flinch.

lines.zh: 你背上那口气快用完了
lines.en: The air on your back is running low.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你看清了吗
lines.en: I'm this small. Did you even see me?

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进海床的沙
lines.en: Your boots are sinking into seabed sand.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只是不喜欢被捏
lines.en: I don't fear people. I dislike being squeezed.

lines.zh: 你腰上的玻璃瓶，我认得
lines.en: The glass bottle at your waist. I know it.

lines.zh: 手指一碰，我就黏上去
lines.en: One touch of your finger and I cling.

lines.zh: 海底的光在你脸上晃
lines.en: Seabed light flickers across your face.

lines.zh: 我被压扁了一点
lines.en: I got squashed a little.

lines.zh: 黏液流出来了，止不住
lines.en: Slime is leaking out. Can't stop it.

lines.zh: 我的触角断了半截
lines.en: Half of one feeler is gone.

lines.zh: 水一下子浑了，我看不清
lines.en: The water went cloudy. I can't see.

lines.zh: 别捏我，我里面全是软的
lines.en: Don't squeeze. I'm soft all through.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，慢慢等
lines.en: I curl into a dot and wait it out.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里，凉得发麻
lines.en: The wound is cold and numb underwater.

lines.zh: 我往沙里钻，钻不深
lines.en: I dig into the sand. Not deep enough.

lines.zh: 这一下够我缓半天
lines.en: That one will take me half a day.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来吧，我游不动
lines.en: Scoop me up. I can't swim.

lines.zh: 那团绿藻，我能吃一整天
lines.en: That clump of algae could feed me all day.

lines.zh: 你手里的瓶子，别晃
lines.en: That bottle in your hand. Don't shake it.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，那是陆上的东西
lines.en: No bread. That's dry-land food.

lines.zh: 把藻放在沙上，我自己过去
lines.en: Set the algae on the sand. I'll come over.

lines.zh: 这味道像退潮后的礁石
lines.en: Smells like a reef at low tide.

lines.zh: 靠太近我会缩成一小团
lines.en: Too close and I curl into a tiny ball.

lines.zh: 我只想慢慢啃，别催
lines.en: I just want to graze slowly. Don't rush.

lines.zh: 你的手指比藻更让我好奇
lines.en: Your finger interests me more than the algae.

lines.zh: 那瓶子是空的吧，我听见响
lines.en: That bottle's empty, isn't it? I hear it.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎藻，我全收了
lines.en: The algae bits you scatter. I'll take them all.

lines.zh: 水流把我撞得翻了个身
lines.en: The current knocked me onto my side.

lines.zh: 你膝盖碰到我了，很轻
lines.en: Your knee touched me. Gently.

lines.zh: 我太软，撞一下就变形
lines.en: I'm so soft. One bump reshapes me.

lines.zh: 别在水里踢腿，会踩到我
lines.en: Don't kick underwater. You'll step on me.

lines.zh: 我贴在礁石上，撞不动的
lines.en: I'm stuck to the reef. Can't be bumped off.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼掀起一阵沙
lines.en: Your flipper stirs up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我滑开了，黏液太滑
lines.en: I slid away. My slime is too slick.

lines.zh: 慢些，我躲不过你的腿
lines.en: Slow down. I can't dodge your legs.

lines.zh: 我被挤到珊瑚缝里了
lines.en: I got squeezed into a coral gap.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，黏液黏住了你的鞋
lines.en: After the bump, my slime stuck to your boot.

lines.zh: 海床这边安静，就这里吧
lines.en: This part of the seabed is quiet. Here.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会像一串小米粒
lines.en: Our eggs will look like a string of millet.

lines.zh: 你先绕着我转一圈
lines.en: Circle me once first.

lines.zh: 两只并排，慢得像石头
lines.en: Two side by side, slow as stones.

lines.zh: 潮水会把卵带到远处
lines.en: The tide will carry the eggs far off.

lines.zh: 我身上的花纹和你不太一样
lines.en: My patterns differ from yours.

lines.zh: 别被鱼看见，往藻里躲
lines.en: Don't let the fish see. Into the algae.

lines.zh: 这一季的藻够养活它们
lines.en: This season's algae will feed them.

lines.zh: 我们分不开，黏液粘住了
lines.en: We can't part. The slime holds us.

lines.zh: 等潮退了，再各走各的
lines.en: When the tide ebbs, we go our own ways.

lines.zh: 你拿桶来，我就知道要挪窝
lines.en: You bring a bucket. I know I'm moving.

lines.zh: 桶里有水，我还活得下去
lines.en: There's water in the bucket. I'll survive.

lines.zh: 别把我放在干地上
lines.en: Don't set me on dry ground.

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶贴上来，凉
lines.en: The glass bottle touches me. Cold.

lines.zh: 我在瓶里转了一圈，出不去
lines.en: I circle inside the bottle. No way out.

lines.zh: 桶壁太滑，我贴不住
lines.en: Bucket walls are too smooth to cling to.

lines.zh: 你晃桶，我就跟着晃
lines.en: You sway the bucket. I sway with it.

lines.zh: 这里的水比海里闷
lines.en: This water feels stuffier than the sea.

lines.zh: 放我回去的时候，慢一点
lines.en: When you put me back, do it slowly.

lines.zh: 瓶底那点黏液，别倒掉
lines.en: Don't pour out the slime at the bottom.

lines.zh: 有鱼在啄礁石，离我远点
lines.en: A fish is pecking the reef. Keep your distance.

lines.zh: 那影子贴得太近了
lines.en: That shadow is far too close.

lines.zh: 收起触角，装成一块石头
lines.en: Feelers in. I pass for a stone.

lines.zh: 它要是张嘴，我就喷黏液
lines.en: If it opens its mouth, I'll squirt slime.

lines.zh: 这海床没什么好抢的
lines.en: Nothing here worth fighting over.

lines.zh: 我听见鳃盖开合的声音
lines.en: I hear gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 它绕了两圈，还没走
lines.en: It circled twice and hasn't left.

lines.zh: 我往藻丛里缩，那里乱
lines.en: I sink into the algae. Too tangled there.

lines.zh: 它咬了一口海草，不是我
lines.en: It bit the seagrass, not me.

lines.zh: 它好像犹豫了，我不合口味
lines.en: It seems to hesitate. I don't taste right.

lines.zh: 我不动，看它敢不敢靠近
lines.en: I stay still. Let it dare come closer.

lines.zh: 它的嘴比我的身子还大
lines.en: Its mouth is bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙，尽量不出影子
lines.en: I hug the sand to cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就往礁石后挪
lines.en: When it turns, I slip behind the reef.

lines.zh: 我数着它摆尾的次数
lines.en: I count the sweeps of its tail.

lines.zh: 水里全是它的味道，腥
lines.en: The water tastes of it. Fishy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往深处退，不惊动它
lines.en: I retreat deeper without startling it.

lines.zh: 它冲过来了，我缩成一粒
lines.en: It lunges. I shrink to a speck.

lines.zh: 礁石的洞刚好容下我
lines.en: The hole in the reef just fits me.

lines.zh: 它走了，我还没敢伸触角
lines.en: It's gone. I still won't extend my feelers.

lines.zh: 我喷出一小股黏液，糊它眼睛
lines.en: I squirt slime into its eye.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，推不动它
lines.en: With this strength I can't push it.

lines.zh: 我咬住海草，借力躲开
lines.en: I bite the seagrass and swing clear.

lines.zh: 它被黏液糊住，游歪了
lines.en: Slime in its face. It swims crooked.

lines.zh: 我滚下礁石，摔进沙里
lines.en: I roll off the reef into the sand.

lines.zh: 我身上滑，它抓不住
lines.en: I'm too slick to grab.

lines.zh: 这一下我疼，但没散
lines.en: That hurt, but I held together.

lines.zh: 我把身体压扁，钻进缝
lines.en: I flatten myself into the crack.

lines.zh: 黏液用完了，得歇一阵
lines.en: Out of slime. I need to rest.

lines.zh: 别为我冒险，我太小了
lines.en: Don't risk yourself for me. I'm tiny.

lines.zh: 我在浅海的沙上醒来
lines.en: I wake on the sand of the shallows.

lines.zh: 周围全是陌生的藻味
lines.en: All around, unfamiliar algae smells.

lines.zh: 先找一个能藏身的礁洞
lines.en: First, find a reef hole to hide in.

lines.zh: 我身上还没长出花纹
lines.en: My patterns haven't grown in yet.

lines.zh: 上面有光，说明水不深
lines.en: Light above. The water isn't deep.

lines.zh: 一只海星趴在旁边，不动
lines.en: A starfish lies nearby, still.

lines.zh: 洋流把我推离了出生地
lines.en: The current carried me from my birthplace.

lines.zh: 我得慢慢适应这股咸味
lines.en: I must get used to this saltiness.

lines.zh: 涨潮时会有更多同伴来
lines.en: More of my kind come with the high tide.

lines.zh: 这附近的海草刚长出来
lines.en: The seagrass here is newly grown.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，热气烫到我
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface. The heat stings.

lines.zh: 从礁石上掉下来，摔在沙上
lines.en: Fell off the reef onto the sand.

lines.zh: 这水太深，我沉到了底部
lines.en: Too deep here. I've sunk to the bottom.

lines.zh: 冲击波把水搅成白沫
lines.en: The blast churned the water white.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉擦着我的身旁过去
lines.en: A harpoon grazed past my side.

lines.zh: 水里的光变了颜色，我发麻
lines.en: The light in the water changed. I go numb.

lines.zh: 藻被啃光了，我饿得透明
lines.en: The algae's gone. Hunger makes me translucent.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，整片水都在震
lines.en: Lightning hit the sea. The water shakes.

lines.zh: 我被吸向没有水的地方
lines.en: I'm pulled toward a place with no water.
